Model card: API Try Docs Blog LFM3-Audio-2B-MLX-4bit 4-bit MLX version of LFM3-Audio-2B for Apple Silicon. The weights take 1.58 GB, plus 0.15 GB for the audio codec in . The language backbone uses 4-bit affine quantization with groups of 64, except for the token embedding (also the output layer) and the value and feed-forward down projections in the layers that llama.cpp's Q4_K_M upgrades, which use 6 bits. The audio encoder, audio projector, depth decoder and codebook embedding stay in BF16. The audio codec is the original one. It is the smallest variant and loses some accuracy, so 8-bit is the recommended trade-off. Find architecture and usage details in the original model card. Use with MLX-VLM Requires MLX-VLM 0.7.11 or later: Speech output samples with , and , the defaults in . The original model card lists the voices, languages and other system prompts. More options in the MLX guide.
